Name: MII_VS_Labor_Laborergebnis_Semiquantitativ
Title: MII VS Laboratory Result Semiquantitative
Description: Coding for semi-quantitative laboratory results

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Bestimmung_Ergebnis_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology General Determination Result [SNOMED]
Description: Result ValueSet for general determination: the identified microorganism, or the negative result if no pathogen was identified.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Bestimmung_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology General Determination Method [SNOMED]
Description: Method ValueSet for general determination: non-culture-based procedures for identifying a pathogen without a predefined target, such as microscopy or MALDI-TOF.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Bestimmung_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology General Determination Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for general determination: LOINC codes for the untargeted identification of a microorganism. 41852-5 is preferred; the remaining codes are equally permitted where the laboratory names the pathogen group or the sequencing target in the code.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Kultur_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology General Culture Method [SNOMED]
Description: Method ValueSet for general culture: culture procedures without restriction to a predefined pathogen, including aerobic and anaerobic incubation.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Kultur_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology General Culture Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for general culture: LOINC codes for untargeted culture investigation. 11475-1 is preferred because the code names the procedure itself; 41852-5 is equally permitted.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Mikroskopie_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology General Microscopy Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for general microscopy: nominal LOINC codes for microscopic observation whose result is the morphology seen. 105059-0 is preferred because it is method-neutral; the codes with a stain in the name (Gram, acid-fast, rhodamine-auramine) are equally permitted and leave Observation.method free in return.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Antigen_Antikoerper_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Antigen Antibody Method [SNOMED]
Description: Method ValueSet for quantitative antigen and antibody tests and for avidity determination: immunological detection procedures.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Antigen_Antikoerper_Quantitativ_Einheiten_UCUM
Title: MII VS Microbiology Antigen Antibody Quantitative Units [UCUM]
Description: Unit ValueSet for quantitative antigen and antibody tests (UCUM). Bound to Observation.valueQuantity.code.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Antigen_Antikoerper_Quantitative_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Antigen Antibody Quantitative Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for quantitative antigen and antibody tests: LOINC codes for measuring pathogen-specific antigens or antibodies.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Aviditaet_Ergebnis
Title: MII VS Microbiology Avidity Result
Description: Assessment ValueSet for avidity: categorical classification of the avidity index as low, borderline or high. Low avidity indicates a recent infection.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Aviditaet_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Avidity Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for avidity determination: LOINC codes for avidity tests including the target antigen.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Bartlett_Score_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Bartlett Score [LOINC]
Description: Result ValueSet for the Bartlett score: score categories from +3 to -1 that rate the ratio of inflammatory to epithelial cells and thus the suitability of a sputum specimen for culture.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Befundtyp_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Report Type [LOINC]
Description: Specialised coding of microbiological reports

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_CT_Wert_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Ct Value [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for the Ct value: LOINC codes with the property cycle threshold in nucleic acid detection.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Data_Absent_Reason
Title: MII VS Microbiology Data Absent Reason
Description: Reasons for a missing investigation result. Supplements the FHIR base codes with the indeterminable result that was previously coded via value[x].

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Detected_Not_Detected_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Detected Not Detected [SNOMED]
Description: Result ValueSet for targeted qualitative detections: detected or not detected. An indeterminable result is represented not here but via Observation.dataAbsentReason.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Empfindlichkeit_Einheiten_UCUM
Title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Units [UCUM]
Description: Unit ValueSet for phenotypic susceptibility testing (UCUM): minimum inhibitory concentration in mg/L or inhibition zone diameter in mm.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Empfaenglichkeit_Genotyp_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Genotype [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for predicted susceptibility: LOINC codes for the predicted efficacy of an antimicrobial substance derived from the genotype.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Empfindlichkeit_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Method [SNOMED]
Description: Method ValueSet for phenotypic susceptibility testing: the procedures used to measure a minimum inhibitory concentration or an inhibition zone diameter.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Empfindlichkeit_Phenotyp_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Phenotype [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for phenotypic susceptibility testing: LOINC codes of the antimicrobial substance tested.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Faerbung_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Staining [SNOMED]
Description: Staining procedures of the microscopic examination, e.g. Gram stain or Kinyoun stain.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Keimzahl_Einheiten_UCUM
Title: MII VS Microbiology Colony Count Units [UCUM]
Description: Unit ValueSet for colony counting (UCUM): colony-forming units per volume, per mass or as a count per specimen.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Keimzahl_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Colony Count [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for colony counting: LOINC codes for the quantitative determination of viable microorganisms.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Kultur_Ergebnis_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Culture Result [SNOMED]
Description: Result ValueSet for general and specific culture: growth, no growth or an equivocal result. How much has grown is not stated by this ValueSet but by the colony count. An indeterminable result is represented not via value[x] but via Observation.dataAbsentReason.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Culture_Any_Property

Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'General culture: Everything by culture technique (upper bound)', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Candidate pool: every observable with a culture technique regardless of property (identity, threshold, colony counts, susceptibility by culture). Upper bound for review. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 246501002 |Technique (attribute)| = << 703725008 |Culture technique (qualifier value)|`

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_General_Culture_Identity
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology General Culture Identity
Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'General culture: General culture — organism identity by culture technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_General_Microscopy_By_Technique
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology General Microscopy By Technique
Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Microscopy: General microscopy — nominal finding by microscopy or staining technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Parts: LOINC enumeration (203, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (1), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118589004 |Threshold (property) (qualifier value)| OR 705057003 |Presence (property) (qualifier value)|), 246501002 |Technique (attribute)| = << 703725008 |Culture technique (qualifier value)|, (704319004 |Inheres in (attribute)| = << 410607006 |Organism (organism)| OR 246093002 |Component (attribute)| = << 410607006 |Organism (organism)|)`

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Specific_Microscopy_Threshold
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Specific Microscopy Threshold
Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Microscopy: Specific microscopy — ordinal threshold presence by microscopy or staining technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Object sought and stain named in the code, result is the detection (LOINC PrThr + Ord + stain). Host cells (leukocytes, erythrocytes, epithelia) are included because the technique, not a class, selects. Parts: LOINC enumeration (331, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118589004 |Threshold (property) (qualifier value)| OR 705057003 |Presence (property) (qualifier value)|), 370132008 |Scale type (attribute)| = 117363000 |Ordinal value (qualifier value)|, 246501002 |Technique (attribute)| = (<< 278289002 |Microscopy technique (qualifier value)| OR << 703857004 |Staining technique (qualifier value)|)`

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Spezifische_Bestimmung
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Specific determination
Description: Proposal: union of the request ValueSets that together cover the module profile MII_PR_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Bestimmung (Specific determination), each computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_NAA_Detection_Any_Technique, MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Organism_Specific_Culture_Detection, MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Antigen_Detection_Threshold.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Susceptibility_All
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Susceptibility All
Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Susceptibility: All susceptibility observables (upper bound)', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Every observable with Property = Susceptibility, any site, any technique. Upper bound for review; the difference to the two queries above is the set with a non-isolate site (e.g. susceptibility in blood). Parts: LOINC enumeration (1349, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (1), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = 118588007 |Susceptibility (property) (qualifier value)|`

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Susceptibility_Genotype_Predicted
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Susceptibility Genotype Predicted
Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Susceptibility: Predicted susceptibility — by genotype determination technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Genotypic prediction of susceptibility (HIV, HBV, HCV, M. tuberculosis drug resistance mutations). The LOINC filter METHOD_TYP = Genotyping maps to Technique = Genotype determination technique. Parts: LOINC enumeration (81, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = 118588007 |Susceptibility (property) (qualifier value)|, 246501002 |Technique (attribute)| = << 708060009 |Genotype determination technique (qualifier value)|`

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Susceptibility_Phenotype
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Susceptibility Phenotype
Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Susceptibility: Phenotypic susceptibility — isolate, not genotyping', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Susceptibility of a microbial isolate to a substance, excluding observables that assert a genotyping technique (ECL cardinality [0..0]). Matches the phenotype ValueSet intent (MIC, disk diffusion, gradient strip ... any phenotypic method). Parts: LOINC enumeration (1230, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Titer_Any
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Titer Any
Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Titre: Titre — all titre observables (upper bound)', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Every titre observable; the difference to the query above is autoimmune, blood-group and other non-infective titres. Parts: LOINC enumeration (2188, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = 118590008 |Dilution factor expressed as titer (property) (qualifier value)|`

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_LOINC_Ontology_Titer_Infective_Antibody
Title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Titer Infective Antibody
Description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Titre: Titre — pathogen antibody titre', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Titre of an antibody to an infective organism (serology titres: syphilis, Brucella, Widal, viral IgG/IgM titres). Parts: LOINC enumeration (1716, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Mikroskopie_Gesichtsfeld_Einheiten_UCUM
Title: MII VS Microbiology Microscopy Field of View Units [UCUM]
Description: Units for the count per field of view in the quantity component of microscopy.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Mikroskopie_Semiquantitativ_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Microscopy Semiquantitative [SNOMED]
Description: Quantity ValueSet for microscopy: the semiquantitative grade in which a microscopic finding was seen.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Molekulare_Diagnostik_Einheiten_UCUM
Title: MII VS Microbiology Molecular Diagnostics Units [UCUM]
Description: Unit ValueSet for molecular pathogen load (UCUM): concentration units such as copies per millilitre.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Molekulare_Pathogenlast_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Molecular Pathogen Load Method [SNOMED]
Description: Method ValueSet for molecular pathogen load: amplification procedures for quantifying pathogen nucleic acid.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Molekulare_Pathogenlast_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Molecular Pathogen Load Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for molecular pathogen load: quantitative LOINC codes for the nucleic acid concentration of a pathogen.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Morphologie_Ergebnis_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Morphology Result [SNOMED]
Description: Result ValueSet for microscopy: the morphological group observed microscopically, such as Gram-positive cocci in clusters or Gram-negative rods. A species identification does not belong here, even if it was made microscopically.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Morphologie_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Morphology Method [SNOMED]
Description: Method ValueSet for microscopy: the microscopic procedures used. The stain is stated not here but in the extension MII_EX_Mikrobio_Faerbung.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_MRGN_Klasse_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology MRGN Class [LOINC]
Description: Result ValueSet for the MRGN classification: 2MRGN, 3MRGN and 4MRGN according to the RKI categorisation. The negative classification is in the module's own CodeSystem, because the LOINC answer list does not carry it.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Organismen_SNOMEDCT
Title: MII VS Microbiology Organisms [SNOMED CT]
Description: Organism ValueSet: the SNOMED CT hierarchies from which an identified pathogen may come. Not bound directly, but included in the result ValueSets of the determination profiles.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Resistenzkategorie_Status
Title: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Category Status
Description: Investigation codes for assessing a detected pathogen with regard to a defined resistance category.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Resistenzkategorie_Status_Ergebnis
Title: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Category Status Result
Description: Result of assessing a detected pathogen with regard to the resistance category given in Observation.code.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Resistenzmechanismen_Determinanten_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Mechanisms Determinants [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for resistance mechanisms and determinants: LOINC codes for the detection of resistance genes, resistance proteins and functional resistance tests.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Resistenzmechanismen_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Mechanisms Method [SNOMED]
Description: Methods for detecting resistance mechanisms and determinants: molecular, immunological and functional procedures.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Bestimmung_Ergebnis_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Specific Determination Result [SNOMED]
Description: Result ValueSet for specific determination: detection or exclusion of the target already named in the investigation code, including the grey-zone findings weakly positive and equivocal. An indeterminable result is represented not via value[x] but via Observation.dataAbsentReason.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Bestimmung_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Specific Determination Method [SNOMED]
Description: Method ValueSet for specific determination: non-culture-based procedures for targeted pathogen detection, such as amplification, immunoassay or agglutination.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Bestimmung_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Specific Determination Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for specific determination.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Mikroskopie_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Specific Microscopy Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for specific microscopy: ordinal LOINC codes in which the object sought and the staining technique are named in the code; the result is the detection, the quantity is in the quantity component.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Susceptibility
Title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility
Description: Assessment ValueSet for phenotypic susceptibility testing: the categories susceptible, intermediate, susceptible, increased exposure, resistant and non-susceptible.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Susceptibility_NORM
Title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Norm
Description: Norm ValueSet for susceptibility testing: the interpretive standard (e.g. EUCAST, CLSI) on whose breakpoints a category is based. Bound to the extension MII_EX_Mikrobio_Empfindlichkeit_Norm.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Titer_Methode_SNOMED
Title: MII VS Microbiology Titre Method [SNOMED]
Description: Method ValueSet for titre determination: serial dilution procedures.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Titer_Tests_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Titre Tests [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for titre determination: LOINC codes for semiquantitative measurements from dilution series.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Virulenz_LOINC
Title: MII VS Microbiology Virulence [LOINC]
Description: Test ValueSet for virulence factors: LOINC codes for the detection or exclusion of virulence determinants.

Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Voraussichtliche_Empfindlichkeit
Title: MII VS Microbiology Predicted Susceptibility
Description: Result ValueSet for predicted susceptibility: the predicted category susceptible, intermediate or resistant derived from genotypic detections.
